title: ResidencyRL: Reinforcement Learning in Simulated Clinical Environments
abstract: arXiv:2608.07418v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In medical education, physicians convert academic knowledge into clinical expertise through residency: years of training across thousands of encounters, with diverse sources of feedback and progressively greater autonomy. Much of clinical reasoning relies on the patient encounter, a dialogue in which a clinician elicits history, refines diagnostic hypotheses, and decides management under uncertainty. While large language models (LLMs) excel on static medical benchmarks, methods to optimize the full sequence of clinical decisions remain underdeveloped. We present ResidencyRL, a reinforcement learning (RL) method for training clinical artificial intelligence (AI) agents through simulated multi-turn clinical encounters (up to 60 dialogue turns and 8 tool calls per trajectory). ResidencyRL pairs the policy agent with LLM simulators capable of complex, adversarial behaviors, training against a structured reward aligned to diagnostic accur

translated_title: ResidencyRL：模拟临床环境中的强化学习
translated_abstract: 在医学教育中，医生通过住院医师培训将学术知识转化为临床专长：历经数年的训练、数千次的诊疗实践，获得多样化的反馈来源，并逐步获得更大的自主权。临床推理在很大程度上依赖于患者诊疗过程——这是一种对话式的互动，临床医生在其中采集病史、完善诊断假设，并在不确定性下做出治疗决策。虽然大语言模型（LLM）在静态医学基准测试中表现出色，但优化完整临床决策序列的方法仍然发展不足。我们提出了ResidencyRL，这是一种强化学习方法，通过模拟的多轮临床诊疗过程（每次轨迹最多包含60轮对话和8次工具调用）来训练临床人工智能（AI）智能体。ResidencyRL将策略智能体与能够表现出复杂、对抗性行为的LLM模拟器配对，通过与诊断准确性对齐的结构化奖励进行训练。
tldr: ResidencyRL提出了一种强化学习方法，通过模拟多轮临床诊疗环境（含对抗性患者模拟器和结构化诊断奖励）来训练临床AI智能体，使其像住院医师一样在实践互动中提升完整临床决策序列的能力。
en_tdlr: ResidencyRL presents a reinforcement learning method that trains clinical AI agents through simulated multi-turn clinical encounters with adversarial patient simulators and structured diagnostic rewards, enabling them to improve sequential clinical decision-making much like medical residents do in practice.
